phinia-laser-marking-machine-traceabilit.heroTitleLine1: A single serial number for each part,
phinia-laser-marking-machine-traceabilit.heroSub: Developed for Phinia's İzmir ESBAŞ Free Zone factory, the 3-axis laser marking machine combines marking and camera verification in a single automated flow, communicating bi-directionally with Oracle.
phinia-laser-marking-machine-traceabilit.contextTitle: Zero-tolerance production in the free zone
phinia-laser-marking-machine-traceabilit.contextP1: Phinia's factory in the İzmir ESBAŞ Free Zone manufactures for the automotive sector. In this type of production, the origin of each part, the line it came from, and the quality control it passed must be retrospectively traceable.
phinia-laser-marking-machine-traceabilit.contextP2: The project was implemented to uniquely mark each manufactured product and ensure end-to-end traceability. At the center of the task was not only the marking itself, but also guaranteeing that the marking was read correctly.
phinia-laser-marking-machine-traceabilit.problemTitle: Two separate steps, two separate risks
phinia-laser-marking-machine-traceabilit.problemLede: When marking and verification were carried out as disconnected steps open to manual check, two types of gaps arose.

problemList.text: Each part needed to be marked with its own serial number, and this number had to be transferred to the central system.
When verification was done manually as a separate step, a faulty or unreadable code could pass through the line unnoticed.
The disconnection between marking and data recording meant a missing chain in retrospective query.

phinia-laser-marking-machine-traceabilit.solutionLede: The machine, developed turnkey including mechanical design for Phinia, was designed with 3-axis motion capability to operate flexibly. Serial numbers are received from Oracle, engraved on the part, and verified with the camera within the same flow.

steps.title: Get serial number
steps.text: The unique serial number to be printed is retrieved from Oracle.

steps.title: Laser marking
steps.text: The 3-axis servo structure positions the part, and the code is laser-engraved.

steps.title: Camera verification
steps.text: Code content, quality grade, and position are automatically checked.

steps.title: Confirm back to Oracle
steps.text: Confirmation data of compliant parts is written back to Oracle.

techGrid.title: Laser marking device
techGrid.text: Marking unit that permanently engraves the unique serial number on the part.

techGrid.title: 3-axis servo structure
techGrid.text: Servo-driven motion in X-Y-Z axes for flexible positioning.

techGrid.title: PLC field automation
techGrid.text: PLC managing all field signals and workflow within the station.

techGrid.title: SCADA application with C#
techGrid.text: SCADA developed specifically for operator interface and process monitoring.

techGrid.title: Camera-based control
techGrid.text: Automatic verification of code content, grade, and position via image processing.

techGrid.title: Oracle integration
techGrid.text: Bi-directional data exchange with serial number request and confirmation data.

phinia-laser-marking-machine-traceabilit.integrationDesc: The system runs fully integrated with Oracle: serial numbers are retrieved from Oracle, and confirmation data of compliant parts is sent back to Oracle after marking and verification.

integrationList.text: Serial numbers are automatically requested from the Oracle ERP system and transferred to the machine.
Data of approved parts that successfully pass camera control is written back to the Oracle system instantly.

resultsGrid.title: 100% Data Accuracy
resultsGrid.text: Thanks to camera verification and Oracle integration, the risk of faulty code printing or missing data was completely prevented.

resultsGrid.title: Operational Speed
resultsGrid.text: By combining marking and camera verification steps on a single machine, cycle times were optimized.

resultsGrid.title: Full Traceability
resultsGrid.text: The history and quality test results of each manufactured part were permanently recorded in the central system.

phinia-laser-marking-machine-traceabilit.closerTitle: Zero errors with high-performance laser technology and intelligent camera systems.

duru-bulgur-product-carton-pallet-tracea.heroSub: Implemented at Duru Bulgur's Karaman factory, the Product / Box / Pallet Traceability system tracks the entire process from packaging to shipment on a single digital platform, operating fully integrated with ERP.
duru-bulgur-product-carton-pallet-tracea.contextP1: Duru Bulgur's Karaman factory produces bulgur and pulse products. The project was implemented to ensure product, box, and pallet level traceability across the entire process from packaging to shipment on the production lines.
duru-bulgur-product-carton-pallet-tracea.contextP2: The established system aims to eliminate shipment errors while improving inventory management accuracy in the food supply chain.
duru-bulgur-product-carton-pallet-tracea.problemLede: The lack of tracking for packaged food products in the box and pallet hierarchy posed operational risks.

problemList.text: Manual tracking of product, box, and pallet relationships after packaging created a traceability gap.
Lack of visibility on which product was loaded onto which pallet could lead to shipment errors.
In case of potential quality or contamination issues, target-specific product recall was extremely difficult.

duru-bulgur-product-carton-pallet-tracea.solutionLede: The Product | Carton | Pallet traceability application was successfully implemented on production lines at Duru Bulgur's Karaman factory. Product – Box – Pallet – Warehouse – Customer steps were made traceable and manageable on a single platform based on the unique serial number.

steps.title: Product Marking
steps.text: During the packaging stage, products are uniquely marked and gain a traceable identity.

steps.title: Box & Pallet Association
steps.text: Which product goes into which box, and which box onto which pallet is fully recorded (Aggregation).

steps.title: Warehouse Transfers
steps.text: Internal warehouse transfer movements between different locations are instantly recorded using handheld terminals.

steps.title: Customer Shipment
steps.text: Shipment transfers made to customers are recorded, completing the end-to-end data chain.

techGrid.title: PLC field automation
techGrid.text: PLC structure managing field automation and production line workflow.

techGrid.title: SCADA application with C#
techGrid.text: Custom C# application for operator interface, label matching, and process monitoring.

techGrid.title: Industrial Barcode Readers
techGrid.text: Industrial scanners that read product, carton, and pallet barcodes/labels with high precision.

techGrid.title: Handheld Terminal Application
techGrid.text: Recording warehouse transfers, inventory movements, and customer shipments on-site via handheld terminals.

techGrid.title: OnSuite Trace Platform
techGrid.text: Central software layer where traceability and process management are controlled.

techGrid.title: ERP integration
techGrid.text: Bi-directional sharing of transfer data and stock status integrated with the ERP system.

duru-bulgur-product-carton-pallet-tracea.integrationDesc: The traceability application runs fully integrated with Duru Bulgur's existing ERP system: field data, stock movements, and transfer info are instantly pushed to the ERP.

integrationList.text: All warehouse transfer and shipment data recorded from field terminals are instantly written to the ERP.
Product-box-pallet relationships are synchronized with ERP stock status and tracked via a single platform.

resultsGrid.title: End-to-end traceability
resultsGrid.text: The entire chain from packaging to customer became traceable end-to-end based on the unique product serial number.

resultsGrid.title: Zero manual errors
resultsGrid.text: Product-box-pallet relations and warehouse/customer movements are auto-recorded, eliminating manual tracking errors.

resultsGrid.title: Fast recall capability
resultsGrid.text: In case of a potential recall, precise backward tracking capability maximized shipment accuracy and operational safety.

duru-bulgur-product-carton-pallet-tracea.closerTitle: Seamless data flow from packaging to warehouse, and warehouse to customer.

bsh-carriers-traceability.heroSub: Implemented at BSH's Çerkezköy oven factory; brackets mounted on oven glass are tracked by carrier/basket ID, recording the glass-bracket-product component relationship integrated with SAP ERP.
bsh-carriers-traceability.contextTitle: Precision assembly control in oven production
bsh-carriers-traceability.contextP1: In the project implemented at BSH's oven production factory in Çerkezköy, the brackets mounted on the oven glass were tracked and recorded based on the basket ID.
bsh-carriers-traceability.contextP2: The project was carried out to ensure the traceability of the glass–bracket–product component relationship and to prevent assembly errors.
bsh-carriers-traceability.problemLede: There was a risk of incorrect matching of glass and bracket components during oven door assembly.

problemList.text: Incorrect matching of glass and bracket components in oven production and lack of verification for these matches.
Insufficient manual tracking of the component-product relationship, creating a traceability gap.
Inability to detect and block incorrect component pairings in real time during assembly.

bsh-carriers-traceability.solutionLede: Brackets were tracked according to basket IDs. Baskets were scanned at the glass bonding station, verifying oven glass lot numbers against bracket lot numbers. At the assembly stage, the lot number of the relevant glass trolley was associated with the oven's unique serial number.

steps.title: Basket Tracking
steps.text: Brackets mounted on oven glass are made traceable based on their basket IDs.

steps.title: Lot Verification
steps.text: Baskets are scanned at the glass bonding station, verifying oven glass lot numbers against bracket lot numbers.

steps.title: Product Association
steps.text: At the assembly stage, the lot number of the relevant glass trolley is associated with the oven's unique serial number.

steps.title: SAP Confirmation
steps.text: Confirmation data for compliant parts that successfully pass all matches is written back to the SAP ERP system.

techGrid.title: PLC field automation
techGrid.text: PLC infrastructure managing workflow and field signals at the glass bonding station.

techGrid.title: SCADA application with C#
techGrid.text: C# application for verification, product association, and operator displays.

techGrid.title: Industrial Barcode Readers
techGrid.text: High-precision barcode readers scanning glass and bracket lot numbers, as well as basket IDs.

techGrid.title: OnSuite Trace Platform
techGrid.text: Central software layer providing traceability, lot tracking, and process control.

techGrid.title: SAP ERP Integration
techGrid.text: Bi-directional data integration of matching and production confirmations with the SAP system.

techGrid.title: Station Control
techGrid.text: Automatic stop mechanism that halts the line via PLC in case of incorrect bracket usage.

bsh-carriers-traceability.integrationDesc: The process monitoring and verification system runs fully integrated with BSH's SAP ERP infrastructure; production confirmations and lot-matching data are written back to SAP.

integrationList.text: Confirmation data for compliant parts is written to the SAP ERP system in real time after verification.
Glass and bracket lot numbers are validated against SAP inventory and recipe definitions before proceeding.

resultsGrid.title: Correct component matching
resultsGrid.text: The correct match of glass and bracket components during assembly is auto-verified, reducing incorrect part usage to zero.

resultsGrid.title: Serial number level tracking
resultsGrid.text: Component-product relationships are recorded at the product serial number level, ensuring full backward traceability.

resultsGrid.title: Process safety
resultsGrid.text: The line-stopping control on incorrect matches completely prevents non-compliant products from moving to the next station.

bsh-carriers-traceability.closerTitle: Seamless process safety from glass to bracket, assembly to SAP.

turk-demir-dokum-rfid-gate-with-digital-.heroSub: Implemented at Turk Demir Dokum's Bilecik factory; the RFID Gate and Kanban system optimizes warehouse material preparation processes based on the pull methodology.
turk-demir-dokum-rfid-gate-with-digital-.contextTitle: Line feeding optimization in boiler production
turk-demir-dokum-rfid-gate-with-digital-.contextP1: Turk Demir Dokum's Bilecik factory produces combi boilers. The project was implemented to optimize warehouse material preparation processes based on demands from production lines.
turk-demir-dokum-rfid-gate-with-digital-.contextP2: With the RFID gate application, the material flow has been transformed into a demand-driven digital kanban structure, synchronized with the production tempo.
turk-demir-dokum-rfid-gate-with-digital-.problemLede: Managing production line material needs with manual methods caused delays and preparation errors.

problemList.text: Delays experienced in manual material ordering and preparation processes, risking line downtime.
Incorrect transfer of requirements leading to excess inventory or incorrect material feeding in the warehouse.
Inability to synchronize the material flow with real-time production speed and line consumption rates.

turk-demir-dokum-rfid-gate-with-digital-.solutionLede: An RFID Gate application was implemented to optimize warehouse material preparation based on production line needs. More than 300 transport bins were RFID-tagged, automatically generating warehouse material orders as they exited through the RFID gate.

steps.title: RFID Tagging
steps.text: Over 300 transport boxes/bins are equipped with high-precision industrial RFID tags.

steps.title: RFID Gate Scanning
steps.text: Tags are automatically scanned as the boxes pass through the RFID Gate at the production area exit.

steps.title: Automated Ordering
steps.text: Scanned boxes turn into real-time order demands, auto-triggering material replenishment orders to the warehouse.

steps.title: Handheld Terminal Control
steps.text: Warehouse staff prepares and ships the correct parts error-free using RFID handheld terminals.

techGrid.title: RFID Gate reading system
techGrid.text: RFID antenna and transit gate positioned at the production area exit, scanning boxes in motion.

techGrid.title: Industrial RFID tags
techGrid.text: UHF RFID tags mounted on over 300 transport bins, resistant to harsh workshop conditions.

techGrid.title: RFID handheld terminals
techGrid.text: Mobile devices where warehouse staff performs material picking and transfer steps on-site.

techGrid.title: OnSuite Trace Platform
techGrid.text: Central software that converts RFID transit data into order demands and manages the process.

techGrid.title: SAP ERP integration
techGrid.text: Instant transfer of generated warehouse material order records to the SAP ERP system.

techGrid.title: Digital Kanban Control
techGrid.text: Pull control that triggers material flow according to the consumption rate of the production line.

turk-demir-dokum-rfid-gate-with-digital-.integrationDesc: The RFID Gate system runs instantly integrated with Turk Demir Dokum's SAP ERP; order records generated from field transits are automatically processed in SAP.

integrationList.text: An automatic transfer order is created in SAP based on reading data of boxes passing through the RFID gate.
The status of boxes shipped from the warehouse to the line is updated instantly in SAP inventory.

turk-demir-dokum-rfid-gate-with-digital-.resultsTitle: Automated line feeding and optimized warehouse processes

resultsGrid.title: Zero manual orders
resultsGrid.text: Warehouse material preparation is automated with the RFID gate, completely eliminating manual order needs.

resultsGrid.title: Pull methodology
resultsGrid.text: Managing material flow according to the pull basis synchronized with production tempo prevented excess stocking.

resultsGrid.title: Speed and accuracy
resultsGrid.text: Maximum efficiency in warehouse material prep speed and shipment accuracy has been achieved thanks to the digital kanban structure.

turk-demir-dokum-rfid-gate-with-digital-.closerTitle: Seamless and error-free material flow from warehouse to production line with RFID technology.

haier-europe-single-product-traceability.heroSub: Implemented at Haier Europe's Eskişehir cooking appliances factory; serial numbers are associated with RFID to automate safety tests independently of operators, pushing data to the global MES system.
haier-europe-single-product-traceability.contextTitle: Digital transformation on oven assembly lines
haier-europe-single-product-traceability.contextP1: A traceability system was applied to the new oven assembly lines at the cooking appliances factory of Haier Europe, a global leader in home appliances, located in Eskişehir.
haier-europe-single-product-traceability.contextP2: Within the scope of the project, the assembly line automation software was also developed by Siskon, connecting all test stations into a central traceability structure.
haier-europe-single-product-traceability.problemTitle: Secure test verification and registration needs
haier-europe-single-product-traceability.problemLede: Electrical and leak safety tests of each oven produced on the new assembly lines had to be verified independently of operator intervention.

problemList.text: Human error and data inconsistency risks arising from manual execution of safety tests.
Inability to automatically associate electrical, gas leak, and flame control test results with unique product serial numbers.
Lack of an automatic locking mechanism to prevent untested or failed products from advancing along the assembly line.

haier-europe-single-product-traceability.solutionLede: The product barcode is matched with the RFID tag at the line start. Electrical, gas leak, and flame control tests are carried out in automated operator-independent stations, matching results with serial numbers and pushing them to MES.

steps.title: RFID Association
steps.text: At the line start, the serial number from the product barcode is matched with the carrier's RFID tag.

steps.title: Automated Tests
steps.text: Ovens are automatically tested at electrical, gas leak, and flame control test stations, independent of operator intervention.

steps.title: Data Matching
steps.text: Real-time test results collected from stations are automatically associated with the product's unique serial number.

steps.title: MES Confirmation
steps.text: Successfully completed test confirmations are instantly pushed to Haier Europe's Global MES system.

techGrid.title: Assembly line automation software
techGrid.text: Control software managing the entire assembly line workflow and machine stations.

techGrid.title: 9-axis servo & robotic system
techGrid.text: Robotic equipment performing precise positioning and mechanical tasks at the stations.

techGrid.title: RFID traceability infrastructure
techGrid.text: RFID system matching serial numbers at the line start and tracking station transits.

techGrid.title: Automated test units
techGrid.text: Test equipment conducting electrical, gas leak, and flame control tests without human intervention.

techGrid.title: Industrial networks
techGrid.text: High-speed field data exchange over EtherCAT, TCP/IP, and Profinet protocols.

techGrid.title: OnSuite Trace & MES integration
techGrid.text: Data layer where the OnSuite Trace platform runs fully integrated with Haier Global MES.

haier-europe-single-product-traceability.integrationDesc: The developed traceability system runs instantly integrated with Haier Europe's Global MES (Manufacturing Execution System); all test data and confirmations are pushed to MES.

integrationList.text: Electrical, gas leak, and flame control test results are written to the MES system based on the product serial number.
Transition of failed or incomplete products to the next station is blocked based on the MES confirmation state.

haier-europe-single-product-traceability.resultsTitle: Zero-error safety and real-time production tracking

resultsGrid.title: Unique product traceability
resultsGrid.text: End-to-end digital traceability based on serial numbers was provided for each product starting from the line entry.

resultsGrid.title: Operator-independent quality
resultsGrid.text: Electrical, gas leak, and flame control tests are automated, reducing human error rates to zero.

resultsGrid.title: MES data integrity
resultsGrid.text: All quality and test records on the production line are instantly sent to the MES system for centralized reporting.

haier-europe-single-product-traceability.closerTitle: Highest safety standards combined with robotic automation and automated tests.

pmi-barcode-gate.heroSub: Implemented at PMI's Torbalı (İzmir) factory, the Automatic Shipment Barcode Verification System scans pallet labels at the shipment exit, verifies them against shipment orders, and updates SAP-WMS.
pmi-barcode-gate.contextTitle: Fully automated control at shipment exits
pmi-barcode-gate.contextP1: PMI's Torbalı (İzmir) factory is a cigarette manufacturing facility. The produced items are shipped on a pallet basis via exit ramps during the shipment process.
pmi-barcode-gate.contextP2: The project was implemented to automate the pallet verification and shipment order matching process at the shipment exit.
pmi-barcode-gate.problemLede: Checking pallets manually against correct work orders at shipment ramps caused delays and increased shipment error risks.

problemList.text: The risk of incomplete or incorrect barcode products being shipped without detection.
Operational inefficiency caused by manually matching pallet labels with shipment work orders.
Inability to process pallets exiting from ramps into the WMS system instantly and automatically.

pmi-barcode-gate.solutionLede: The barcode gate system installed at the exit ramp automatically reads all pallet labels. The system automatically retrieves shipment orders from SAP-WMS, compares them with pallet labels, and writes data to WMS on match.

steps.title: Work Order Integration
steps.text: Work orders belonging to the shipment plan are automatically loaded from the SAP-WMS system.

steps.title: Ramp Barcode Scanning
steps.text: The Barcode Gate on the exit ramp automatically reads all pallet labels passing over it.

steps.title: Match & Verification
steps.text: Pallet labels are compared with shipment orders to instantly query content accuracy.

steps.title: WMS Confirmation
steps.text: Matched pallet barcodes and the shipment number are instantly sent to the SAP-WMS system.

techGrid.title: Industrial Barcode Readers
techGrid.text: Industrial scanners that read pallet barcodes on the fly at exit ramps without errors.

techGrid.title: PLC field automation
techGrid.text: PLC system managing pallet transits, sensors, and gate flow at the ramp.

techGrid.title: SCADA application with C#
techGrid.text: SCADA software managing matching logic, operator alert screens, and system data integration.

techGrid.title: WMS data layer
techGrid.text: Integration interface where matched pallet barcodes and shipment numbers are pushed to the WMS system.

techGrid.title: Operator Alert System
techGrid.text: Control mechanism providing visual/audible warnings to the operator in case of mismatched or incorrect labels.

techGrid.title: SAP ERP integration
techGrid.text: SAP connection that enables the system to automatically retrieve shipment work orders.

pmi-barcode-gate.integrationDesc: The automatic shipment barcode verification system runs with bi-directional and real-time integration with PMI's SAP-WMS infrastructure; data is verified independent of the operator.

integrationList.text: Shipment work orders in the SAP-WMS system are automatically pulled into the system, ready for verification.
Verified pallet barcodes and associated shipment numbers are written back to the SAP-WMS system in real time.

resultsGrid.title: Automated pallet verification
resultsGrid.text: 100% automated pallet verification is achieved at the shipment exit, eliminating the need for manual checks.

resultsGrid.title: Zero shipment errors
resultsGrid.text: Shipment of products with missing, wrong, or incorrect barcodes from shipment ramps is completely prevented.

resultsGrid.title: Operator warnings
resultsGrid.text: Shipment operations are secured with an instant warning mechanism when an incorrect pallet is detected.

pmi-barcode-gate.closerTitle: Seamless data flow from exit ramps to the warehouse and error-free shipment.
